description: Compose a builder URL with a dedication pre-filled — the name shows on the runner's GPS watch and in the Strava activity title. Use after the user picks a route (find/generate) and decides who the heart is for. Pure URL builder, no server-side state.

city.description: Optional city to also pre-fill in the builder (skips the "pick a city" step in the chat-to-product handoff).

in_memory.description: If true, framed as "In memory of [name]". Default false.

name: add_dedication
